info.title: bamboohr (WorkflowBench simulated)
info.description: BambooHR Human Resources API v1. Authenticates via HTTP Basic (API key as username, 'x' as password) or OAuth 2.0. All paths begin with /api/v1/. Employee fields are requested by name using a comma-separated list. Tabular data (job history, compensation, etc.) is accessed through the tables sub-resource.

get.summary: Retrieve data for a single employee. Returns only the fields specified in the query parameter.
get.description: Retrieve data for a single employee. Returns only the fields specified in the query parameter.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Employee ID. Use '0' to reference the employee linked to the current API key.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: A comma-delimited set of field names specifying which data to return (defaults to firstName,lastName).

parameters.name: onlyCurrent
parameters.description: Controls whether historical table fields return only current data (true, the default) or also include values with effective dates in the future.

200.description: Object containing the requested field name/value pairs for the employee.

post.summary: Modify one or more fields on an existing employee record. Only the supplied fields are changed.
post.description: Modify one or more fields on an existing employee record. Only the supplied fields are changed.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the employee to update.

200.description: 200 OK. No response body on success.

requestBody.description: Body: JSON object of field name/value pairs to update. Any standard employee field may be included (e.g., {firstName, lastName, workEmail, jobTitle, department, location, payRate, ...}).

get.summary: Retrieve the company employee directory, including contact details and job information for all active employees.
get.description: Retrieve the company employee directory, including contact details and job information for all active employees.

parameters.name: onlyCurrent
parameters.description: When true (default), only currently active employees appear. Disable to also return employees whose hire date or status effective date is in the future.

200.description: {fieldsets: [{id, title, fields: [fieldId]}], employees: [{id, displayName, firstName, lastName, preferredName, jobTitle, workPhone, workEmail, department, location, division, photoUrl, ...}]}

post.summary: Add a new employee to the system. Returns the new employee's ID in the response Location header.
post.description: Add a new employee to the system. Returns the new employee's ID in the response Location header.

200.description: 201 Created with Location header containing the new employee URL. No response body.

requestBody.description: Body: {firstName (required), lastName (required), and any combination of standard employee fields such as workEmail, jobTitle, department, division, location, hireDate, address1, city, state, zipcode, country, mobilePhone, homePhone, workPhone, dateOfBirth, ssn, gender, maritalStatus, payRate, payType, exempt, employeeNumber, payFrequency}

get.summary: Retrieve all rows from a specified table for an employee. Standard tables include: jobInfo, employmentStatus, compensati
get.description: Retrieve all rows from a specified table for an employee. Standard tables include: jobInfo, employmentStatus, compensation, dependents, contacts, education, assets, training, customTables.

parameters.name: table
parameters.description: Name of the table to query (e.g., jobInfo, compensation, dependents).

Employee.description: Represents an individual within the BambooHR system. The set of returned fields depends on the 'fields' query parameter.

id.description: System-assigned unique identifier for the employee (read-only).

preferredName.description: The name the employee prefers to go by.

displayName.description: Formatted version of the employee's name for display purposes (read-only).

employeeNumber.description: Company-defined employee number (distinct from BambooHR ID).

originalHireDate.description: First hire date for rehired employees (v1.1+).

terminationDate.description: Date of employment termination (read-only in v1.1+).

status.description: Whether the employee is currently active or inactive.

employmentHistoryStatus.description: Current employment status label (read-only in v1.1+).

jobTitle.description: Employee's current job title. Updating this creates a history entry.

bestEmail.description: Derived field that resolves to the corporate email when present, falling back to the personal email (read-only).

state.description: State or province. The system automatically converts entries to their standard abbreviated form.

supervisor.description: Name of the employee's direct supervisor (read-only).

supervisorEId.description: BambooHR employee ID of the supervisor (read-only).

standardHoursPerWeek.description: Number of standard hours per work week.

acaStatusCategory.description: Affordable Care Act status (e.g., full-time, contractor, intern-eligible).

includeInPayroll.description: Whether this employee should be part of payroll runs.

timeTrackingEnabled.description: Whether time tracking is turned on for this employee.

isPhotoUploaded.description: Indicates if the employee has uploaded a profile photo (read-only).

lastChanged.description: Timestamp of the most recent change to this record.

createdByUserId.description: ID of the user who initially created this employee record (read-only).

photoUrl.description: URL to the employee's profile photo.

TimeOffRequest.description: A request by an employee to use time off. Must be approved before it impacts balances, though sufficiently privileged users can create pre-approved requests.

id.description: Unique identifier for this time off request.

employeeId.description: ID of the employee who submitted the request.

id.description: ID of the time off type.

name.description: Label for the time off type (e.g., Vacation, Sick Leave).

status.description: Current approval state of the request.

lastChanged.description: When the status was last modified.

lastChangedByUserId.description: ID of the user who last changed the status.

start.description: First day of the requested time off period.

end.description: Final day of the requested time off period.

unit.description: Whether the amount is measured in hours or days.

manager.description: Comment provided by the approving manager.

dates.description: Mapping of individual dates (YYYY-MM-DD) to the number of hours/days requested for each.

created.description: Timestamp when the request was originally submitted.

TimeOffType.description: A category of time off configured for the company (e.g., Vacation, Sick, Personal).

id.description: Unique identifier for this time off category.

name.description: Display name of the time off category.

units.description: Whether this type tracks time in hours or days.

color.description: Hex color code used for calendar display.

TimeOffPolicy.description: An accrual or allotment policy governing how employees earn time off.

timeOffTypeId.description: The time off type this policy applies to.

type.description: Mechanism by which time off is granted.

WhosOut.description: A record indicating an employee is absent or on leave during a given time range.

id.description: ID of the time off entry or holiday.

type.description: Whether this is an employee absence or a company holiday.

employeeId.description: ID of the absent employee (absent for holidays).

name.description: Employee's display name or holiday name.

start.description: Start date of the absence or holiday.

end.description: End date of the absence or holiday.

EmployeeFile.description: Metadata for a document stored in an employee's file.

originalFileName.description: Name of the file as originally uploaded.

createdBy.description: Name of the user who uploaded the file.

shareWithEmployee.description: Whether the file is visible to the employee.

FileCategory.description: A folder-like grouping used to organize employee documents.

TableRow.description: A single row in an employee table (e.g., job history, compensation, dependents). Fields vary by table.

employeeId.description: ID of the employee this row belongs to.

Report.description: A generated report containing employee data across selected fields.

fields.description: Column definitions included in the report.

items.description: An employee record containing only the requested fields plus their ID.

employees.description: Collection of employee records matching the report criteria.

Webhook.description: A subscription that sends real-time HTTP notifications when employee or company data changes.

monitorFields.description: Field names that trigger a notification when modified.

postFields.description: Fields to include in the webhook payload.

url.description: Target URL where notifications are delivered.

hour.description: Hour of day for scheduled delivery (0-23).

day.description: Day of the month for monthly delivery.

employeeIds.description: Restrict this webhook to specific employees.

includeCompanyDomain.description: Whether to include the company subdomain in payloads.

created.description: Timestamp when the webhook was set up.

lastSent.description: Timestamp of the last successful delivery.

Goal.description: A performance goal assigned to an employee.

employeeId.description: ID of the employee who owns this goal.

title.description: Short descriptive name for the goal.

description.description: Detailed explanation of what the goal entails.

percentComplete.description: Progress toward completion as a percentage (0-100).

alignsWithOptionId.description: ID of a company-level goal this aligns with.

sharedWithEmployeeIds.description: IDs of employees this goal is shared with.

completionDate.description: Date the goal was actually completed.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the goal.

actions.description: Permissions the current user has on this goal.

TrainingRecord.description: A record of an employee's participation in a training activity.

TrainingType.description: A category of training offered by the company.

renewable.description: Whether this training expires and must be retaken.

dueFromHireDate.description: Number of days after hire by which this training should be completed.

required.description: Whether all employees must complete this training.

category.description: Grouping category for this training type.

BenefitPlan.description: A benefits package or plan offered to employees.

name.description: Display name of the benefits plan.
